bench.name: rom_pipe_exact_anr
bench.cmd:
B={RUN}/bsrc_m5_0; rm -rf $B && mkdir -p $B && for d in *; do ln -s $PWD/$d $B/$d; done && for d in $(cd physical/ref_tile/ot_qwen_tile_lsl_m5/src && ls -d */ | tr -d /); do rm -f $B/$d; cp -a $PWD/$d $B/$d; done && cp -a physical/ref_tile/ot_qwen_tile_lsl_m5/src/. $B/ && cd $B && { mkdir -p {RUN}/bench && python3 tools/rtl_qwen_me_partition_gate_w12.py --ref-file tools/qwen_blocks/ot_hdc_matvec_0e8df511.sv --jobs 8 --param GT=16 --param W=4 --param SMIN=3 --param SMAX=4 --param TCUT=3 --param BD=2 --param NWS=1 --param ORD=1 --param TWS=2 --param MEM_EXTRA=1 --param ACC_LAT=7 --param TREE_LAT=7 --param MUL_LAT=8 --param FAST_ISSUE=1 --param KV_PREP=4 --param ROM_PIPE=1 --param LRST=3 --param ARPB=1 --param MPR=1 --param HIER=2 --param ROM_CAP2=1 --param ROM_CAPX=2 --param ANR=1 --param ROM_ARELAY=2 --param SEED=1 --workdir {RUN}/bench/rom_pipe_exact_anr --result {RUN}/bench/rom_pipe_exact_anr.json; python3 -c "import json;d=json.load(open('{RUN}/bench/rom_pipe_exact_anr.json'));print(('PASS' if d['status']=='pass' else 'FAIL')+' rom_pipe '+d['verdict']+' | neg '+d['negative_control'])"
}
bench.note: [m5rr: run on the e032e6e6f snapshot overlay of physical/ref_tile/ot_qwen_tile_lsl_m5/src]
